video_title: Debating the CASE on why Carmelo Anthony is a BETTER scorer than Kevin Durant 👀

quotes.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
quotes.summary_phrase: Gilbert Arenas argues Carmelo Anthony was a more complete scorer than Kevin Durant
quotes.excerpt: when you're talking about scoring and who's efficient and who's great at scoring, he had all those levels.
quotes.quote: A complete scorer, how you score, how many realms can you play in? If I cut something off, what can you go to? ISO, post-up, flares, down-screen, back-doors, free throws, lays, midis. When you're talking about scoring and who's efficient and who's great at scoring, he had all those levels. So if we say we're taking away his ISO, he can post up. Take away his post-up, he can just go off screens. He can go down. If you really want to know what his package was, look at Olympics. When he had to just be efficient and just catch and shoot, didn't have to play with the ball, led the team in scoring every year, with all the best players on the team.
